{
  "object_type": "cabinet",
  "assumptions": [
    "构件为独立落地式简单长方体柜体，不包含门、抽屉、层板、背板、踢脚、把手或其他附加构件。",
    "默认总宽度为600mm、总深度为400mm、总高度为800mm。",
    "采用局部坐标原点位于柜体左下后角，A为宽度，B为深度，ZZYZX为高度。",
    "当前以单一实体箱体表达，保留后续拆分为板件组合的工程修改空间。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "使用一个轴对齐长方体表达柜体主体。",
    "柜体范围为X方向0至A、Y方向0至B、Z方向0至ZZYZX。",
    "不生成任何门板、抽屉、层板、背板、踢脚或五金。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "主体箱体：BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX。"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：Length类型，标准宽度参数，默认600mm。",
    "B：Length类型，标准深度参数，默认400mm。",
    "ZZYZX：Length类型，标准高度参数，默认800mm。",
    "mat_body：Material类型，柜体主体材质，默认使用通用木质或项目默认材质。",
    "show_2d_outline：Boolean类型，是否在2D脚本中绘制简化外轮廓，默认1。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "尺寸：A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "材质：mat_body。",
    "显示：show_2d_outline。"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [
    "_width = A。",
    "_depth = B。",
    "_height = ZZYZX。",
    "_eps = 0.001m，用于必要时避免共面或数值判断问题。",
    "当前不需要内宽、内高、门宽、层板间距等派生参数。"
  ],
  "command_candidates": [
    "BLOCK：创建主体长方体。",
    "MATERIAL：设置主体材质。",
    "PROJECT2：从3D几何生成默认2D投影。",
    "HOTSPOT2：在平面图中提供宽度和深度编辑热点。",
    "ADD、DEL：如后续拆分板件或增加局部构件时用于变换栈管理。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "先设置主体材质，再调用BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX生成唯一主体。",
    "保持几何命令最少化，不使用PRISM_、REVOLVE、MESH或复杂轮廓。",
    "不生成可选附加构件，避免无意义的循环和开关逻辑。",
    "脚本结构预留后续扩展位置，未来可将单体BLOCK替换为侧板、顶板、底板等板件组合。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "优先使用PROJECT2生成与3D一致的平面投影。",
    "若需要稳定、简洁的平面符号，可在show_2d_outline为1时使用RECT2或LINE2绘制A×B外轮廓。",
    "2D脚本中加入宽度方向和深度方向的HOTSPOT2，以支持图形化修改。",
    "不绘制门缝、把手、层板线或其他不存在的构件。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "为A、B、ZZYZX设置Length类型和非空默认值：600mm、400mm、800mm。",
    "为mat_body设置Material类型和有效默认材质。",
    "为show_2d_outline设置Boolean类型，默认值为1。",
    "限制尺寸参数为正值，并在异常值时回退到合理最小值或发出参数警告。",
    "保留A、B、ZZYZX作为标准Archicad对象尺寸参数，避免改用自定义等价参数。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "按尺寸、材质、显示三个组组织参数界面。",
    "尺寸组显示宽度、深度和高度，使用毫米单位。",
    "材质组提供mat_body材质选择器。",
    "显示组提供2D外轮廓开关；当前仅作为显示控制，不影响3D几何。",
    "界面保持简洁，不为尚未存在的门、层板或五金增加无效参数。"
  ],
  "material_strategy": [
    "主体统一使用mat_body材质。",
    "默认材质采用项目通用木质柜体材质或通用家具材质。",
    "不区分内部、外部、门板和五金材质，因为当前没有附加构件。",
    "后续拆分板件时可扩展为mat_body、mat_edge或mat_front等材质参数。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "3D尺寸由A、B、ZZYZX直接控制，保证参数修改后箱体同步更新。",
    "2D中设置原点参考热点，并分别沿X方向和Y方向设置宽度、深度编辑热点。",
    "高度通常通过对象参数面板修改；如需立面拖拽编辑，可后续增加立面HOTSPOT2策略。",
    "避免热点与几何边界重合造成选择困难，必要时将参考热点放置在外轮廓附近。"
  ],
  "validation_checks": [
    "A、B、ZZYZX必须大于0。",
    "默认值应保持为A=600mm、B=400mm、ZZYZX=800mm。",
    "BLOCK的三个尺寸参数必须按宽、深、高顺序传入。",
    "材质参数mat_body必须为有效Material类型且不可为空。",
    "3D脚本中的ADD、DEL若未来使用必须严格配对。",
    "2D投影外轮廓应与3D外包络一致，避免缩放或坐标方向错误。",
    "确认对象不意外生成门、层板、背板、踢脚或把手。"
  ],
  "knowledge_sources": [
    "core.planning_contract：柜体对象族、基础参数、脚本职责和2D策略。",
    "core.parameter_rules：A、B、ZZYZX标准尺寸参数、Length和Material类型及命名原则。",
    "archetype.cabinet：柜体参数化建模、BLOCK优先策略、PROJECT2和HOTSPOT2应用。",
    "BLOCK命令知识：适用于轴对齐矩形实体的简洁长方体建模。",
    "PROJECT2命令知识：从3D几何生成一致的2D投影。",
    "HOTSPOT2命令知识：实现平面图中的交互式尺寸编辑。"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "单一BLOCK表达的是实体箱体，不代表真实板材厚度；若用于下料或构造深化，后续应改为板件组合。",
    "当前没有内部空间、开启方向或构件间隙等柜体语义。",
    "PROJECT2在不同视图设置下可能产生与手工符号不同的显示效果。",
    "用户若将A、B、ZZYZX设为极小或负值，可能导致无效几何或警告。",
    "材质名称和默认材质依赖项目库，跨项目加载时可能需要重新映射。"
  ]
}

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.600 ! Width
Length B = 0.400 ! Depth
Length ZZYZX = 0.800 ! Height
Material mat_body = 0 ! Cabinet body material
Boolean show_2d_outline = 1 ! Show 2D outline

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A <= 0 THEN A = 0.600
IF B <= 0 THEN B = 0.400
IF ZZYZX <= 0 THEN ZZYZX = 0.800

_width = A
_depth = B
_height = ZZYZX
_eps = 0.001

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_body
BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX
END

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
RESOL 12

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

IF show_2d_outline THEN
    RECT2 0, 0, A, B
    LINE2 0, 0, A, 0
    LINE2 A, 0, A, B
    LINE2 A, B, 0, B
    LINE2 0, B, 0, 0
ENDIF

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl]
VALUES "A" RANGE [0.001, 10.000]
VALUES "B" RANGE [0.001, 10.000]
VALUES "ZZYZX" RANGE [0.001, 10.000]
VALUES "show_2d_outline" 0, 1
LOCK "A", "B", "ZZYZX"

{
  "object_type": "bookshelf",
  "assumptions": [
    "构件为开放式板式书架，不包含柜门、抽屉或装饰线脚。",
    "A 为总宽度，B 为总深度，ZZYZX 为总高度，默认分别为 600 mm、300 mm、1200 mm。",
    "shelf_count 表示层板总数，包含底板和顶板，默认值为 4。",
    "书架以底部 Z=0、宽度沿 X、深度沿 Y、高度沿 Z 的局部坐标系建模。",
    "左右侧板贯穿全高，顶板、底板和中间层板布置在两侧板之间。",
    "背板默认关闭，以保持开放式书架的通用性。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "左右侧板：两块全高矩形板。",
    "底板与顶板：布置在左右侧板内侧之间。",
    "中间层板：根据 shelf_count 自动生成，均匀分布在底板与顶板之间。",
    "可选背板：位于书架后侧，沿宽度和高度布置。",
    "所有板件采用轴对齐矩形实体，避免不必要的复杂曲面建模。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "左侧板：BLOCK frame_thk, B, ZZYZX。",
    "右侧板：通过 ADDX 定位后生成，与左侧板保持对称。",
    "底板：BLOCK inner_width, B, shelf_thickness。",
    "顶板：在总高度减去 shelf_thickness 的位置生成。",
    "中间层板：使用 FOR/NEXT 循环，在底板上表面至顶板下表面之间均匀布置。",
    "背板：可选 BLOCK A, back_thk, ZZYZX，使用 ADDY 定位到后侧。"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：Length，书架总宽度，默认 600 mm，保留为 Archicad 标准参数。",
    "B：Length，书架总深度，默认 300 mm，保留为 Archicad 标准参数。",
    "ZZYZX：Length，书架总高度，默认 1200 mm，保留为 Archicad 标准参数。",
    "frame_thk：Length，左右侧板厚度，默认 18 mm。",
    "shelf_thickness：Length，层板厚度，默认 18 mm。",
    "shelf_count：Integer，层板总数且包含顶板和底板，默认 4，最小值 2。",
    "has_back_panel：Boolean，是否生成背板，默认 0。",
    "back_thk：Length，背板厚度，默认 6 mm。",
    "mat_frame：Material，侧板及框架材质，默认木质材料。",
    "mat_shelf：Material，层板材质，默认木质材料。",
    "mat_back：Material，背板材质，默认板材材料。",
    "show_2d_shelves：Boolean，2D 平面中是否显示层板线，默认 1。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "基本尺寸：A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "板件尺寸：frame_thk、shelf_thickness、back_thk。",
    "层板控制：shelf_count。",
    "构造开关：has_back_panel、show_2d_shelves。",
    "材质：mat_frame、mat_shelf、mat_back。"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [
    "_safe_width = MAX(A, 2 * frame_thk)，用于防止内部净宽为负。",
    "_inner_width = MAX(A - 2 * frame_thk, 0)，左右侧板之间的净宽。",
    "_safe_height = MAX(ZZYZX, 2 * shelf_thickness)，用于保证上下板能够生成。",
    "_usable_height = MAX(ZZYZX - 2 * shelf_thickness, 0)。",
    "_shelf_gap = MAX((_usable_height - MAX(shelf_count - 2, 0) * shelf_thickness) / MAX(shelf_count - 1, 1), 0)，用于计算层板间净空。",
    "_actual_count = MAX(INT(shelf_count), 2)，用于保护层数循环。",
    "_back_y = MAX(B - back_thk, 0)，用于背板定位。",
    "_has_valid_inner_width = A > 2 * frame_thk。",
    "_has_valid_height = ZZYZX >= 2 * shelf_thickness。"
  ],
  "command_candidates": [
    "BLOCK：生成侧板、顶板、底板、中间层板和背板。",
    "ADDX、ADDY、ADDZ：定位各板件。",
    "DEL：严格配平每次坐标变换。",
    "FOR/NEXT：按照 shelf_count 生成中间层板。",
    "MATERIAL：按框架、层板和背板分别应用材质。",
    "PROJECT2：从 3D 几何生成一致的 2D 投影。",
    "HOTSPOT2：提供平面图中的宽度和深度编辑热点。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "按侧板、底板、顶板、中间层板、背板的顺序生成几何。",
    "每个板件采用独立的 ADD/DEL 坐标变换，确保变换栈数量严格配对。",
    "侧板材质使用 mat_frame，顶板、底板及中间层板使用 mat_shelf，背板使用 mat_back。",
    "中间层板循环从第 2 块至第 shelf_count-1 块，避免重复生成顶板和底板。",
    "层板位置依据 _shelf_gap 和 shelf_thickness 计算，确保层板在总高度范围内均匀分布。",
    "在无效尺寸或净宽不足时仍生成安全的非负 BLOCK，避免脚本运行错误。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "优先使用 PROJECT2 生成与 3D 模型一致的平面投影和立面表达。",
    "使用 HOTSPOT2 建立外包络角点或边界热点，支持平面中拖拽调整 A、B。",
    "可选使用 RECT2 或 LINE2 补充简化平面符号和层板线，受 show_2d_shelves 控制。",
    "2D 图形不额外绘制背板厚度细节，避免在不同投影方向下产生重复线。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "为 A、B、ZZYZX、frame_thk、shelf_thickness、back_thk 设置 Length 类型和非空默认值。",
    "为 shelf_count 设置 Integer 类型、默认值 4、最小值 2，并在脚本中再次取整和保护。",
    "为 has_back_panel 和 show_2d_shelves 设置 Boolean 类型。",
    "为 mat_frame、mat_shelf、mat_back 设置 Material 类型和合理默认材质。",
    "保持参数名称与 paramlist.xml、脚本引用完全一致。",
    "当 A、B 或 ZZYZX 被修改时，允许对象自动重新计算层板间距。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "按基本尺寸、板件尺寸、层板控制、构造开关和材质建立界面分组。",
    "将 shelf_count 显示为层数输入或步进控件，并提示该数值包含顶板和底板。",
    "将 has_back_panel 和 show_2d_shelves 显示为复选框。",
    "将材质参数显示为材质选择控件。",
    "对过小的总宽度、总高度或过大的板厚给出界面提示或警告文本。"
  ],
  "material_strategy": [
    "侧板、顶板和底板可使用 mat_frame 或统一使用框架材质。",
    "中间层板使用 mat_shelf，以便区分层板饰面。",
    "背板使用 mat_back，默认采用较薄的板材材质。",
    "不在几何脚本中硬编码材质编号，材质全部通过 Material 参数控制。",
    "必要时可将 mat_frame 与 mat_shelf 默认指向同一种木饰面材质。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "在 2D 脚本中设置宽度方向热点，关联 A 参数。",
    "设置深度方向热点，关联 B 参数。",
    "可设置高度方向热点，关联 ZZYZX 参数；若使用 PROJECT2，应确保热点位置与投影方向一致。",
    "shelf_count 和 shelf_thickness 主要通过参数面板编辑，不建议用 2D 拖拽热点直接修改离散层数。",
    "热点位置应使用对象外包络或基准面，避免随层板数量变化而跳动。"
  ],
  "validation_checks": [
    "检查 A、B、ZZYZX、frame_thk、shelf_thickness、back_thk 均为正值或经过安全钳制。",
    "检查 A > 2 * frame_thk，否则提示侧板占满或内部净宽为零。",
    "检查 ZZYZX >= 2 * shelf_thickness，否则提示顶板和底板无法合理布置。",
    "检查 shelf_count 为不小于 2 的整数。",
    "检查 shelf_count=2 时不执行中间层板循环。",
    "检查层板最高点不超过总高度，且顶板与底板不发生重叠。",
    "检查背板开启时 B >= back_thk，且背板位置位于后侧。",
    "检查所有 ADD、ADDX、ADDY、ADDZ 均有对应 DEL。",
    "检查 2D 脚本与 3D 脚本使用相同参数名和派生逻辑。",
    "检查默认参数生成的书架尺寸为 600 mm × 300 mm × 1200 mm，默认共 4 块层板。"
  ],
  "knowledge_sources": [
    "core.planning_contract：书架对象族、板式组合、参数和脚本职责约定。",
    "core.parameter_rules：A、B、ZZYZX 标准参数、Length/Material/Boolean 类型和命名规则。",
    "archetype.bookshelf：侧板、顶板、底板、中间层板、可选背板及 BLOCK、FOR/NEXT、PROJECT2、HOTSPOT2 策略。",
    "Wiki BLOCK：使用 BLOCK 生成轴对齐矩形板件。",
    "Wiki ADD_DEL：使用 ADD/DEL 管理局部坐标和变换栈。",
    "Wiki FOR_NEXT：使用循环生成重复层板。",
    "Wiki PROJECT2：从 3D 几何派生 2D 投影。",
    "Wiki HOTSPOT2：实现 2D 图形交互编辑。"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "用户给定高度 1200 mm 低于常见独立书架默认高度范围，因此应以用户尺寸优先，不套用通用默认高度。",
    "shelf_count 若被误解为中间层板数量，会导致实际层数与预期不符；界面必须明确其包含顶板和底板。",
    "层板厚度增大时可用净空可能变为零，需要派生参数保护和提示。",
    "背板开启后会占用部分深度，需明确其位于 B 的后侧且不改变对象总深度。",
    "过小的 A 或 ZZYZX 可能导致板件重叠，必须在参数脚本或 Master 脚本中进行约束。",
    "PROJECT2 的投影效果依赖 Archicad 视图和投影设置，必要时需用手工 2D 线条补充。",
    "不同 Archicad 版本对参数列表、UI 脚本和投影命令细节可能存在差异，工程实施时需进行实际编译验证。"
  ]
}

{
  "object_type": "普通对象型单扇门构件，预留升级为墙宿主 Door subtype 的接口",
  "assumptions": [
    "默认门洞宽度 A=900mm，门洞高度 ZZYZX=2100mm。",
    "B 作为门框及门扇沿墙厚方向的总深度，默认 150mm，可理解为墙体或门套参考深度。",
    "门框采用左右竖框加上框的矩形组合，不默认生成墙洞。",
    "门扇默认关闭状态显示在门洞内，2D 平面图显示开启方向和开启弧线。",
    "handing=1 表示左开，handing=2 表示右开；开启方向按平面图观察约定。",
    "GDL 内部长度单位遵循当前 Archicad 工程单位，默认值可按 0.9m、2.1m、0.15m 表达。",
    "对象以普通 Object 形式规划，若需要自动墙洞、门编号和原生门属性，应改为 Door subtype 并补充宿主逻辑。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "门框：左竖框、右竖框、上框三个 BLOCK 组成。",
    "门扇：单块矩形薄板，宽度按门洞宽度扣除门框净宽控制。",

Length A = 0.600 ! 总宽度
Length B = 0.300 ! 总深度
Length ZZYZX = 1.200 ! 总高度
Length frame_thk = 0.018 ! 左右侧板厚度
Length shelf_thickness = 0.018 ! 层板厚度
Integer shelf_count = 4 ! 层板总数，包含底板和顶板
Boolean has_back_panel = 0 ! 是否生成背板
Length back_thk = 0.006 ! 背板厚度
Material mat_frame = 1 ! 框架材质
Material mat_shelf = 1 ! 层板材质
Material mat_back = 1 ! 背板材质
Boolean show_2d_shelves = 1 ! 2D中显示层板线

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Bookshelf Master Script
! 参数校验与派生尺寸计算

IF A < 0.100 THEN A = 0.100
IF B < 0.100 THEN B = 0.100
IF ZZYZX < 0.100 THEN ZZYZX = 0.100

IF frame_thk < 0.001 THEN frame_thk = 0.001
IF shelf_thickness < 0.001 THEN shelf_thickness = 0.001
IF back_thk < 0.001 THEN back_thk = 0.001
IF shelf_count < 2 THEN shelf_count = 2

IF frame_thk > A / 2 THEN frame_thk = A / 2
IF shelf_thickness > ZZYZX / 2 THEN shelf_thickness = ZZYZX / 2
IF back_thk > B THEN back_thk = B

_safe_width = MAX(A, 2 * frame_thk)
_inner_width = MAX(A - 2 * frame_thk, 0)
_safe_height = MAX(ZZYZX, 2 * shelf_thickness)
_usable_height = MAX(ZZYZX - 2 * shelf_thickness, 0)

_actual_count = MAX(INT(shelf_count), 2)
_inner_shelf_count = MAX(_actual_count - 2, 0)
_shelf_gap = MAX((_usable_height - _inner_shelf_count * shelf_thickness) / MAX(_actual_count - 1, 1), 0)

_back_y = MAX(B - back_thk, 0)
_has_valid_inner_width = A > 2 * frame_thk
_has_valid_height = ZZYZX >= 2 * shelf_thickness

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! Bookshelf 2D Script

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Bookshelf 3D Script
! 坐标：宽度沿X，深度沿Y，高度沿Z

! 左右侧板
MATERIAL mat_frame
BLOCK frame_thk, B, ZZYZX

ADDX A - frame_thk
BLOCK frame_thk, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 底板
MATERIAL mat_shelf
ADD frame_thk, 0, 0
BLOCK _inner_width, B, shelf_thickness
DEL 1

! 顶板
ADD frame_thk, 0, ZZYZX - shelf_thickness
BLOCK _inner_width, B, shelf_thickness
DEL 1

! 中间层板
IF _actual_count > 2 THEN
    FOR i = 2 TO _actual_count - 1
        ADD frame_thk, 0, shelf_thickness + (i - 1) * (_shelf_gap + shelf_thickness)
        BLOCK _inner_width, B, shelf_thickness
        DEL 1
    NEXT i
ENDIF

! 可选背板，位于Y方向后侧
IF has_back_panel THEN
    MATERIAL mat_back
    ADDY _back_y
    BLOCK A, back_thk, ZZYZX
    DEL 1
ENDIF

END

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! L-shaped steel profile validation and derived dimensions

IF flange_width < 0.001 THEN
    flange_width = 0.001
ENDIF

IF flange_thickness < 0.001 THEN
    flange_thickness = 0.001
ENDIF

IF web_height < 0.001 THEN
    web_height = 0.001
ENDIF

IF web_thickness < 0.001 THEN
    web_thickness = 0.001
ENDIF

IF member_length < 0.001 THEN
    member_length = 0.001
ENDIF

IF flange_width < web_thickness THEN
    flange_width = web_thickness
ENDIF

_total_height = web_height + 2 * flange_thickness
_total_width = flange_width
_inner_clear_width = flange_width - web_thickness

IF corner_radius < 0 THEN
    corner_radius = 0
ENDIF

_corner_limit = MIN(flange_thickness, web_thickness)
_corner_limit = MIN(_corner_limit, _inner_clear_width / 2)

IF _corner_limit < 0 THEN
    _corner_limit = 0
ENDIF

IF corner_radius > _corner_limit THEN
    corner_radius = _corner_limit
ENDIF

! Straight-flight stair master script

IF n_steps < 1 THEN n_steps = 1
IF riser_height < 0.001 THEN riser_height = 0.001
IF tread_depth < 0.001 THEN tread_depth = 0.001
IF stair_width < 0.1 THEN stair_width = 0.1
IF tread_thickness < 0.001 THEN tread_thickness = 0.001
IF riser_thickness < 0.001 THEN riser_thickness = 0.001

_step_count = MAX(1, ROUND(n_steps, 0))
_width = stair_width
_rise = MAX(0.001, riser_height)
_going = MAX(0.001, tread_depth)
_tread_thk = MAX(0.001, tread_thickness)
_riser_thk = MAX(0.001, riser_thickness)

_total_rise = _step_count * _rise
_total_run = _step_count * _going
_last_tread_z = start_level + _total_rise

A = _width
B = _total_rise
ZZYZX = _total_rise

VALUES "A" RANGE [0.1, 5.0]
VALUES "B" RANGE [0.1, 10.0]
VALUES "ZZYZX" RANGE [0.1, 10.0]

VALUES "n_steps" RANGE [1, 100]
VALUES "riser_height" RANGE [0.001, 0.5]
VALUES "tread_depth" RANGE [0.05, 1.0]
VALUES "stair_width" RANGE [0.1, 5.0]
VALUES "tread_thickness" RANGE [0.001, 0.2]

VALUES "has_risers" 0, 1
VALUES "riser_thickness" RANGE [0.001, 0.1]
VALUES "start_level" RANGE [-10.0, 10.0]

VALUES "show_2d_risers" 0, 1
VALUES "show_2d_arrow" 0, 1
VALUES "pen_2d" RANGE [1, 255]

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
PEN 1
TOLER 0.001

HOTSPOT 0, 0, start_level
HOTSPOT 0, _width, start_level
HOTSPOT _total_run, 0, _last_tread_z
HOTSPOT 0, 0, _last_tread_z

MATERIAL mat_tread

FOR i = 1 TO _step_count
    ADD (i - 1) * _going, 0, start_level + i * _rise - _tread_thk
    GOSUB "DrawTread"
    DEL 1
NEXT i

IF has_risers THEN
    MATERIAL mat_riser
    FOR i = 1 TO _step_count
        ADD i * _going - _riser_thk, 0, start_level + (i - 1) * _rise
        GOSUB "DrawRiser"
        DEL 1
    NEXT i
ENDIF

END

"DrawTread":
    BLOCK _going, _width, _tread_thk
RETURN

"DrawRiser":
    BLOCK _riser_thk, _width, _rise
RETURN

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl
PEN pen_2d

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 _total_run, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, _width
HOTSPOT2 _total_run, _width

RECT2 0, 0, _total_run, _width

FOR i = 1 TO _step_count
    LINE2 i * _going, 0, i * _going, _width
NEXT i

IF show_2d_risers THEN
    FOR i = 1 TO _step_count
        LINE2 i * _going, 0, i * _going, _width
    NEXT i
ENDIF

IF show_2d_arrow THEN
    LINE2 _total_run * 0.5, _width * 0.5, _total_run * 0.8, _width * 0.5
    LINE2 _total_run * 0.8, _width * 0.5, _total_run * 0.7, _width * 0.5 + _width * 0.08
    LINE2 _total_run * 0.8, _width * 0.5, _total_run * 0.7, _width * 0.5 - _width * 0.08
ENDIF

Length ZZYZX = 1.500 ! Window opening height
Length frame_thk = 0.070 ! External frame face width
Length frame_depth = 0.070 ! External frame depth
Length glass_thk = 0.024 ! Glass thickness
Length sash_width = 0.540 ! Opening sash width
Length sash_frame_thk = 0.055 ! Opening sash frame width
Length sash_depth = 0.060 ! Opening sash depth
Angle sash_open_angle = 0.000 ! Opening angle
Integer sash_hinge_side = 1 ! Hinge side: 0 left, 1 right
Boolean has_opening_sash = 1 ! Show opening sash
Boolean show_handle = 0 ! Show simplified handle
Material mat_frame = 0 ! External frame material
Material mat_sash = 0 ! Opening sash material
Material mat_glass = 0 ! Glass material
Boolean show_2d_opening_arc = 1 ! Show opening arc in 2D
Boolean show_2d_glass = 1 ! Show glass lines in 2D
Boolean show_frame_3d = 1 ! Show external frame in 3D
Boolean show_glass_3d = 1 ! Show glass in 3D

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl
! Window master script: validation and derived dimensions

IF A < 0.300 THEN A = 0.300
IF B < 0.020 THEN B = 0.020
IF ZZYZX < 0.300 THEN ZZYZX = 0.300
IF frame_thk < 0.010 THEN frame_thk = 0.010
IF frame_depth < 0.010 THEN frame_depth = 0.010
IF glass_thk < 0.004 THEN glass_thk = 0.004
IF sash_frame_thk < 0.010 THEN sash_frame_thk = 0.010
IF sash_depth < 0.010 THEN sash_depth = 0.010
IF sash_hinge_side < 0 THEN sash_hinge_side = 0
IF sash_hinge_side > 1 THEN sash_hinge_side = 1
IF sash_open_angle < 0 THEN sash_open_angle = 0
IF sash_open_angle > 180 THEN sash_open_angle = 180

_frame_gap = MAX (0.002, MIN (0.005, frame_thk * 0.05))
_clear_width = MAX (0.020, A - 2 * frame_thk)
_clear_height = MAX (0.020, ZZYZX - 2 * frame_thk)
_min_glass_width = 0.080
_min_glass_height = 0.080

_sash_min_width = 2 * sash_frame_thk + _min_glass_width
_sash_max_width = MAX (_sash_min_width, _clear_width - _frame_gap)
IF sash_width < _sash_min_width THEN sash_width = _sash_min_width
IF sash_width > _sash_max_width THEN sash_width = _sash_max_width

_sash_clear_width = MAX (_min_glass_width, sash_width - 2 * sash_frame_thk)
_sash_clear_height = MAX (_min_glass_height, _clear_height - 2 * sash_frame_thk)
_fixed_clear_width = MAX (0.020, _clear_width - sash_width - _frame_gap)

IF sash_hinge_side = 0 THEN
    _sash_x = frame_thk
    _fixed_x = frame_thk + sash_width + _frame_gap
    _hinge_x = frame_thk
ELSE
    _sash_x = A - frame_thk - sash_width
    _fixed_x = frame_thk
    _hinge_x = A - frame_thk
ENDIF

_fixed_glass_y = MAX (0.002, (frame_depth - glass_thk) / 2)
_sash_y = MAX (0.002, (frame_depth - sash_depth) / 2)
_sash_glass_y = MAX (0.002, (sash_depth - glass_thk) / 2)

! Host context references for Window subtype compatibility
_wall_thickness_ref = WALL_THICKNESS
_wall_height_ref = WALL_HEIGHT
_seo_mode_ref = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
! Parametric wall-hosted window geometry
RESOL 24

IF show_frame_3d THEN
    MATERIAL mat_frame
    BLOCK frame_thk, frame_depth, ZZYZX
    ADDX A - frame_thk
    BLOCK frame_thk, frame_depth, ZZYZX
    DEL 1
    ADDZ ZZYZX - frame_thk
    BLOCK A - 2 * frame_thk, frame_depth, frame_thk
    DEL 1
    BLOCK A - 2 * frame_thk, frame_depth, frame_thk
ENDIF

IF show_glass_3d THEN
    MATERIAL mat_glass
    ADD _fixed_x, _fixed_glass_y, frame_thk
    BLOCK _fixed_clear_width, glass_thk, _clear_height
    DEL 1
ENDIF

IF has_opening_sash THEN
    ADD _hinge_x, _sash_y, frame_thk
    IF sash_hinge_side = 1 THEN
        MUL -1, 1, 1
        ROTZ -sash_open_angle
    ELSE
        ROTZ sash_open_angle
    ENDIF

    IF show_frame_3d THEN
        MATERIAL mat_sash
        BLOCK sash_width, sash_depth, sash_frame_thk
        ADDX sash_width - sash_frame_thk
        BLOCK sash_frame_thk, sash_depth, _clear_height
        DEL 1
        ADDZ _clear_height - sash_frame_thk
        BLOCK sash_width, sash_depth, sash_frame_thk
        DEL 1
        BLOCK sash_frame_thk, sash_depth, _clear_height
    ENDIF

    IF show_glass_3d THEN
        MATERIAL mat_glass
        ADD sash_frame_thk, _sash_glass_y, sash_frame_thk
        BLOCK _sash_clear_width, glass_thk, _sash_clear_height
        DEL 1
    ENDIF

    IF show_handle THEN
        MATERIAL mat_sash
        ADD sash_width - sash_frame_thk - 0.025, sash_depth, ZZYZX / 2
        BLOCK 0.025, 0.018, 0.080
        DEL 1
    ENDIF

    DEL 3
ENDIF

END

! Parametric window plan symbol
PEN 1
RESOL 24

! Window opening envelope
LINE2 0, 0, A, 0
LINE2 A, 0, A, B
LINE2 A, B, 0, B
LINE2 0, B, 0, 0

! External frame
LINE2 frame_thk, 0, A - frame_thk, 0
LINE2 frame_thk, B, A - frame_thk, B
LINE2 frame_thk, 0, frame_thk, B
LINE2 A - frame_thk, 0, A - frame_thk, B

IF show_2d_glass THEN
    IF sash_hinge_side = 0 THEN
        LINE2 frame_thk + sash_width + _frame_gap, 0, A - frame_thk, 0
        LINE2 frame_thk + sash_width + _frame_gap, B, A - frame_thk, B
    ELSE
        LINE2 frame_thk, 0, A - frame_thk - sash_width - _frame_gap, 0
        LINE2 frame_thk, B, A - frame_thk - sash_width - _frame_gap, B
    ENDIF
ENDIF

IF has_opening_sash THEN
    IF sash_hinge_side = 0 THEN
        LINE2 frame_thk, 0, frame_thk + sash_width, 0
        LINE2 frame_thk + sash_width, 0, frame_thk + sash_width, B
        LINE2 frame_thk + sash_width, B, frame_thk, B
        IF show_2d_opening_arc THEN
            ARC2 frame_thk, 0, sash_width, 0, sash_open_angle
        ENDIF
    ELSE
        LINE2 A - frame_thk, 0, A - frame_thk - sash_width, 0
        LINE2 A - frame_thk - sash_width, 0, A - frame_thk - sash_width, B
        LINE2 A - frame_thk - sash_width, B, A - frame_thk, B
        IF show_2d_opening_arc THEN
            ARC2 A - frame_thk, 0, sash_width, 180 - sash_open_angle, 180
        ENDIF
    ENDIF
ENDIF

HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 _hinge_x, 0
HOTSPOT2 _sash_x, 0
HOTSPOT2 _sash_x + sash_width, 0

Material bottom_rail_material = 0 ! Bottom rail material

Boolean show_2d_bottom_rail = 1 ! Show bottom rail in 2D
Integer post_count = 2 ! Automatically calculated post count

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < post_diameter * 2 THEN
    A = post_diameter * 2
ENDIF

IF B < handrail_outer_diameter THEN
    B = handrail_outer_diameter
ENDIF

IF max_post_spacing <= 0 THEN
    max_post_spacing = 1.000
ENDIF

IF post_diameter <= 0 THEN
    post_diameter = 0.042
ENDIF

IF handrail_outer_diameter <= 0 THEN
    handrail_outer_diameter = 0.050
ENDIF

IF handrail_wall_thickness < 0 THEN
    handrail_wall_thickness = 0
ENDIF

IF handrail_wall_thickness >= handrail_outer_diameter / 2 THEN
    handrail_wall_thickness = handrail_outer_diameter / 2
ENDIF

IF bottom_rail_diameter <= 0 THEN
    bottom_rail_diameter = 0.032
ENDIF

IF bottom_rail_height < bottom_rail_diameter / 2 THEN
    bottom_rail_height = bottom_rail_diameter / 2
ENDIF

IF bottom_rail_height > B - bottom_rail_diameter / 2 THEN
    bottom_rail_height = B - bottom_rail_diameter / 2
ENDIF

IF post_base_clearance < 0 THEN
    post_base_clearance = 0
ENDIF

IF post_base_clearance >= B THEN
    post_base_clearance = 0
ENDIF

IF max_post_spacing < post_diameter THEN
    max_post_spacing = post_diameter
ENDIF

post_count = INT(A / max_post_spacing)

IF A / max_post_spacing > post_count THEN
    post_count = post_count + 1
ENDIF

post_count = post_count + 1

IF post_count < 2 THEN
    post_count = 2
ENDIF

actual_post_spacing = A / (post_count - 1)
handrail_center_z = B - handrail_outer_diameter / 2
bottom_rail_center_z = MAX(bottom_rail_diameter / 2, bottom_rail_height)
post_height = B - post_base_clearance
handrail_inner_diameter = MAX(0, handrail_outer_diameter - 2 * handrail_wall_thickness)

VALUES "show_2d_bottom_rail" 0, 1

LOCK "handrail_inner_diameter"

LOCK "bottom_rail_center_z"
LOCK "post_height"

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
TOLER 0.001
PEN 1

MATERIAL post_material

FOR i = 0 TO post_count - 1
    ADD i * actual_post_spacing, 0, post_base_clearance
    GOSUB "DrawPost"
    DEL 1
NEXT i

MATERIAL handrail_material
ADD 0, 0, handrail_center_z
ROTY 90
GOSUB "DrawHandrail"
DEL 2

IF has_bottom_rail THEN
    MATERIAL bottom_rail_material
    ADD 0, 0, bottom_rail_center_z
    ROTY 90
    GOSUB "DrawBottomRail"
    DEL 2
ENDIF

END

"DrawPost":
    CYLINDER post_height, post_diameter / 2
RETURN

"DrawHandrail":

! Pipe elbow master script
! Internal units are meters.

! Required Archicad context variables
_seo_mode = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE
_wall_context = WALL_THICKNESS
_height_context = WALL_HEIGHT

IF A <= 0.001 THEN
    A = 0.100
ENDIF

IF pipe_outer_diameter <= 0.001 THEN
    pipe_outer_diameter = A
ENDIF

! A is the master outer-diameter parameter.
pipe_outer_diameter = A

IF wall_thickness <= 0.0001 THEN
    wall_thickness = A * 0.05
ENDIF

IF wall_thickness >= A * 0.499 THEN
    wall_thickness = A * 0.20
ENDIF

_inner_diameter = A - 2 * wall_thickness
IF _inner_diameter <= 0.0001 THEN
    wall_thickness = A * 0.20
    _inner_diameter = A - 2 * wall_thickness
ENDIF

IF inlet_length < 0 THEN
    inlet_length = 0
ENDIF

IF outlet_length < 0 THEN
    outlet_length = 0
ENDIF

! B follows the inlet straight length.
B = inlet_length

IF bend_angle < 45 THEN
    bend_angle = 45
ENDIF

IF bend_angle > 135 THEN
    bend_angle = 135
ENDIF

IF bend_angle <> 45 AND bend_angle <> 90 AND bend_angle <> 135 THEN
    bend_angle = 90
ENDIF

_outer_radius = A / 2
_inner_radius = _inner_diameter / 2

IF bend_radius <= _outer_radius THEN
    bend_radius = A * 1.5
ENDIF

IF segments < 8 THEN
    segments = 8
ENDIF

IF segments > 96 THEN
    segments = 96
ENDIF

IF profile_segments < 8 THEN
    profile_segments = 8
ENDIF

IF profile_segments > 32 THEN
    profile_segments = 32
ENDIF

_angle_rad = bend_angle * PI / 180
_bend_length = bend_radius * _angle_rad
_bend_outer_radius = bend_radius + _outer_radius
_bend_inner_radius = bend_radius - _outer_radius

! End point of the outlet centerline.
_outlet_x = bend_radius * SIN(_angle_rad)
_outlet_y = bend_radius * (1 - COS(_angle_rad))
_outlet_dir_x = COS(_angle_rad)
_outlet_dir_y = SIN(_angle_rad)

! Z envelope equals the outside diameter.
ZZYZX = A

! Derived values used by the 2D and 3D scripts.
_pipe_inner_diameter = _inner_diameter
_pipe_outer_radius = _outer_radius
_pipe_inner_radius = _inner_radius
_bend_centerline_radius = bend_radius
_bend_angle_rad = _angle_rad
_centerline_length = _bend_length
_endpoint_x = _outlet_x
_endpoint_y = _outlet_y
_endpoint_dir_x = _outlet_dir_x
_endpoint_dir_y = _outlet_dir_y

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
! Parametric hollow pipe elbow
! The bend is a revolved annular circular profile.
! Entry axis: +X. Bend plane: XY.

TOLER 0.001
RESOL segments

PEN 1
MATERIAL mat_pipe

! Inlet straight annular pipe segment.
! Local CYLIND axis is Z; rotate it to the X axis.
ADD -inlet_length, 0, 0
ROTY 90
CYLIND inlet_length, _pipe_outer_radius
DEL 2

! Revolved annular elbow profile.
! The profile is defined in the radial/vertical plane.
! Its center is translated to (0, bend_radius), then rotated
! so the arc starts at the inlet tangent.
ADD 0, bend_radius, 0
ROTZ -90

REVOLVE_ 16, bend_angle, mat_pipe, mat_pipe, mat_inner, 63,
    bend_radius + _pipe_outer_radius, 0, 0,
    bend_radius + _pipe_outer_radius * 0.70710678, _pipe_outer_radius * 0.70710678, 0,
    bend_radius, _pipe_outer_radius, 0,
    bend_radius - _pipe_outer_radius * 0.70710678, _pipe_outer_radius * 0.70710678, 0,
    bend_radius - _pipe_outer_radius, 0, 0,
    bend_radius - _pipe_outer_radius * 0.70710678, -_pipe_outer_radius * 0.70710678, 0,
    bend_radius, -_pipe_outer_radius, 0,
    bend_radius + _pipe_outer_radius * 0.70710678, -_pipe_outer_radius * 0.70710678, 0,
    bend_radius + _pipe_inner_radius, 0, 0,
    bend_radius + _pipe_inner_radius * 0.70710678, -_pipe_inner_radius * 0.70710678, 0,
    bend_radius, -_pipe_inner_radius, 0,
    bend_radius - _pipe_inner_radius * 0.70710678, -_pipe_inner_radius * 0.70710678, 0,
    bend_radius - _pipe_inner_radius, 0, 0,
    bend_radius - _pipe_inner_radius * 0.70710678, _pipe_inner_radius * 0.70710678, 0,
    bend_radius, _pipe_inner_radius, 0,
    bend_radius + _pipe_inner_radius * 0.70710678, _pipe_inner_radius * 0.70710678, 0
DEL 2

! Outlet straight pipe segment.
! It follows the tangent at the end of the bend.
ADD _outlet_x, _outlet_y, 0
ROTZ bend_angle
ROTY 90
CYLIND outlet_length, _pipe_outer_radius
DEL 3

! Optional centerline indication.
IF show_centerline THEN
    PEN 3
    ADD 0, 0, _pipe_outer_radius
    LINE 2, 0, 0, inlet_length, 0
    DEL 1
ENDIF

! 3D editing hotspots.
IF show_end_hotspots THEN
    HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0, 1, 0
    HOTSPOT -inlet_length, 0, 0, 2, 0
    HOTSPOT _outlet_x, _outlet_y, 0, 3, 0
    HOTSPOT _outlet_x + _outlet_dir_x * outlet_length,
        _outlet_y + _outlet_dir_y * outlet_length, 0, 4, 0
    HOTSPOT 0, bend_radius, _pipe_outer_radius, 5, 0
ENDIF

END

! Pipe elbow plan symbol
PEN 1

! Required bounding hotspots.
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

! Inlet centerline and outer outline.
LINE2 -inlet_length, 0, 0, 0
LINE2 -inlet_length, _pipe_outer_radius, 0, _pipe_outer_radius
LINE2 -inlet_length, -_pipe_outer_radius, 0, -_pipe_outer_radius

! Bend centerline and outer/inner arcs.
IF show_2d_centerline THEN
    PEN 3
    ARC2 0, bend_radius, bend_radius, -90, -90 + bend_angle
ENDIF

PEN 1
ARC2 0, bend_radius, bend_radius + _pipe_outer_radius, -90, -90 + bend_angle
ARC2 0, bend_radius, bend_radius - _pipe_outer_radius, -90, -90 + bend_angle

! Outlet outline.
LINE2 _outlet_x - _outlet_dir_y * _pipe_outer_radius,
    _outlet_y + _outlet_dir_x * _pipe_outer_radius,
    _outlet_x + _outlet_dir_x * outlet_length - _outlet_dir_y * _pipe_outer_radius,
    _outlet_y + _outlet_dir_y * outlet_length + _outlet_dir_x * _pipe_outer_radius

LINE2 _outlet_x + _outlet_dir_y * _pipe_outer_radius,
    _outlet_y - _outlet_dir_x * _pipe_outer_radius,
    _outlet_x + _outlet_dir_x * outlet_length + _outlet_dir_y * _pipe_outer_radius,
    _outlet_y + _outlet_dir_y * outlet_length - _outlet_dir_x * _pipe_outer_radius

! 幕墙单元格 Master Script
! 所有长度单位为米

_eps = 0.001

_safeA = MAX(A, _eps)
_safeB = MAX(B, _eps)
_safeDepth = MAX(frame_depth, _eps)

IF n_vertical_bays < 1 THEN n_vertical_bays = 1
IF n_horizontal_bays < 1 THEN n_horizontal_bays = 1

_safeVerticalBays = INT(MAX(1, n_vertical_bays))
_safeHorizontalBays = INT(MAX(1, n_horizontal_bays))

_vf = MIN(MAX(vertical_frame_width, _eps), MAX(_eps, _safeA / 2 - _eps))
_hf = MIN(MAX(horizontal_frame_width, _eps), MAX(_eps, _safeB / 2 - _eps))

_vd = MAX(vertical_frame_depth, _eps)
_hd = MAX(horizontal_frame_depth, _eps)
_inset = MAX(glass_inset, 0)

_internalVerticalCount = MAX(0, _safeVerticalBays - 1)
_internalHorizontalCount = MAX(0, _safeHorizontalBays - 1)

_verticalNetWidth = MAX(_eps, (_safeA - 2 * _vf - _internalVerticalCount * _vf) / _safeVerticalBays)
_horizontalNetHeight = MAX(_eps, (_safeB - 2 * _hf - _internalHorizontalCount * _hf) / _safeHorizontalBays)

_glassWidth = _verticalNetWidth + 2 * MIN(_inset, _verticalNetWidth / 2)
_glassHeight = _horizontalNetHeight + 2 * MIN(_inset, _horizontalNetHeight / 2)

_glassThickness = 0.010
_glassYPosition = MIN(MAX(_inset, 0), MAX(0, _safeDepth - _glassThickness))

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
! 幕墙单元格 3D Script

PEN frame_pen
MATERIAL mat_frame

GOSUB "DrawOuterFrames"

IF show_internal_frames THEN
    GOSUB "DrawInternalFrames"
ENDIF

IF show_glass THEN
    GOSUB "DrawGlassPanels"
ENDIF

END

"DrawOuterFrames":
    ! 左竖框
    ADD 0, 0, 0
    BLOCK _vf, _vd, _safeB
    DEL 1

    ! 右竖框
    ADD _safeA - _vf, 0, 0
    BLOCK _vf, _vd, _safeB
    DEL 1

    ! 下横框
    ADD _vf, 0, 0
    BLOCK _safeA - 2 * _vf, _hd, _hf
    DEL 1

    ! 上横框
    ADD _vf, 0, _safeB - _hf
    BLOCK _safeA - 2 * _vf, _hd, _hf
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawInternalFrames":
    ! 内部竖框
    FOR _iVertical = 1 TO _internalVerticalCount
        _xVertical = _vf + _iVertical * (_verticalNetWidth + _vf)
        ADD _xVertical, 0, _hf
        BLOCK _vf, _vd, MAX(_eps, _safeB - 2 * _hf)
        DEL 1
    NEXT _iVertical

    ! 内部横框
    FOR _iHorizontal = 1 TO _internalHorizontalCount
        _zHorizontal = _hf + _iHorizontal * (_horizontalNetHeight + _hf)
        ADD _vf, 0, _zHorizontal
        BLOCK _safeA - 2 * _vf, _hd, _hf
        DEL 1
    NEXT _iHorizontal
RETURN

"DrawGlassPanels":
    MATERIAL mat_glass

    FOR _iGlassX = 0 TO _safeVerticalBays - 1
        _glassX = _vf + _iGlassX * (_verticalNetWidth + _vf)
        _panelWidth = _verticalNetWidth + 2 * MIN(_inset, _verticalNetWidth / 2)

        FOR _iGlassZ = 0 TO _safeHorizontalBays - 1
            _glassZ = _hf + _iGlassZ * (_horizontalNetHeight + _hf)
            _panelHeight = _horizontalNetHeight + 2 * MIN(_inset, _horizontalNetHeight / 2)

            ADD _glassX - MIN(_inset, _verticalNetWidth / 2), _glassYPosition, _glassZ - MIN(_inset, _horizontalNetHeight / 2)
            BLOCK _panelWidth, _glassThickness, _panelHeight
            DEL 1
        NEXT _iGlassZ
    NEXT _iGlassX
RETURN

! Circular dining table master script

_seo_mode = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE
_wall_thickness = WALL_THICKNESS
_wall_height = WALL_HEIGHT

IF table_diameter < 0.4 THEN table_diameter = 0.4
IF top_thk < 0.005 THEN top_thk = 0.005
IF leg_height < 0.1 THEN leg_height = 0.1
IF leg_diameter < 0.01 THEN leg_diameter = 0.01
IF leg_inset < 0 THEN leg_inset = 0
IF leg_count < 1 THEN leg_count = 1
IF leg_count > 12 THEN leg_count = 12

leg_count = INT(leg_count)

A = table_diameter
B = table_diameter
ZZYZX = leg_height + top_thk

_top_radius = table_diameter / 2
_leg_radius = leg_diameter / 2
_leg_center_radius = _top_radius - leg_inset - _leg_radius

IF _leg_center_radius < _leg_radius THEN _leg_center_radius = _leg_radius

_leg_angle_step = 360 / leg_count
_leg_top_z = leg_height
_leg_bottom_z = 0
_total_height = leg_height + top_thk
_center_x = table_diameter / 2
_center_y = table_diameter / 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Circular dining table 3D script

RESOL 32

MATERIAL mat_leg

FOR _leg_index = 0 TO leg_count - 1
    ADD _center_x, _center_y, _leg_bottom_z
    ROTZ leg_start_angle + _leg_index * _leg_angle_step
    ADDX _leg_center_radius
    CYLIND _leg_top_z - _leg_bottom_z, _leg_radius
    DEL 3
NEXT _leg_index

MATERIAL mat_top

ADD _center_x, _center_y, _leg_top_z
CYLIND top_thk, _top_radius
DEL 1

END

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! Circular dining table 2D plan script

RESOL 32

IF show_hotspots THEN
    HOTSPOT2 _center_x, _center_y
    HOTSPOT2 _center_x + _top_radius, _center_y
    HOTSPOT2 _center_x, _center_y + _top_radius
ENDIF

CIRCLE2 _center_x, _center_y, _top_radius

LINE2 _center_x - _top_radius, _center_y, _center_x + _top_radius, _center_y
LINE2 _center_x, _center_y - _top_radius, _center_x, _center_y + _top_radius

IF show_leg_centers_2d THEN
    FOR _leg_index = 0 TO leg_count - 1
        _leg_angle = leg_start_angle + _leg_index * _leg_angle_step
        _leg_x = _center_x + _leg_center_radius * COS(_leg_angle)
        _leg_y = _center_y + _leg_center_radius * SIN(_leg_angle)
        CIRCLE2 _leg_x, _leg_y, _leg_radius
    NEXT _leg_index
ENDIF

HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! H-section column-beam connection validation

IF node_height < 0.20 THEN node_height = 0.20
IF ZZYZX < node_height THEN ZZYZX = node_height
IF A < column_width + beam_length THEN A = column_width + beam_length
IF B < column_depth THEN B = column_depth

IF column_flange_thk < 0.006 THEN column_flange_thk = 0.006
IF column_web_thk < 0.006 THEN column_web_thk = 0.006
IF beam_flange_thk < 0.006 THEN beam_flange_thk = 0.006
IF beam_web_thk < 0.006 THEN beam_web_thk = 0.006

IF column_width < 2 * column_flange_thk + column_web_thk + 0.010 THEN column_width = 2 * column_flange_thk + column_web_thk + 0.010
IF column_depth < 2 * column_flange_thk + 0.010 THEN column_depth = 2 * column_flange_thk + 0.010
IF beam_width < beam_web_thk + 0.010 THEN beam_width = beam_web_thk + 0.010
IF beam_depth < 2 * beam_flange_thk + beam_web_thk + 0.010 THEN beam_depth = 2 * beam_flange_thk + beam_web_thk + 0.010

IF bolt_rows < 1 THEN bolt_rows = 1
IF bolt_cols < 1 THEN bolt_cols = 1
IF stiffener_count < 1 THEN stiffener_count = 1

IF bolt_pitch_v < bolt_diameter * 2.5 THEN bolt_pitch_v = bolt_diameter * 2.5
IF bolt_pitch_h < bolt_diameter * 2.5 THEN bolt_pitch_h = bolt_diameter * 2.5
IF bolt_edge_v < bolt_diameter * 2 THEN bolt_edge_v = bolt_diameter * 2
IF bolt_edge_h < bolt_diameter * 2 THEN bolt_edge_h = bolt_diameter * 2

_bolt_group_width = (bolt_cols - 1) * bolt_pitch_h
_bolt_group_height = (bolt_rows - 1) * bolt_pitch_v
_bolt_group_required_width = _bolt_group_width + 2 * bolt_edge_h
_bolt_group_required_height = _bolt_group_height + 2 * bolt_edge_v

IF plate_width < _bolt_group_required_width THEN plate_width = _bolt_group_required_width
IF plate_height < _bolt_group_required_height THEN plate_height = _bolt_group_required_height
IF node_height < plate_height + 0.10 THEN node_height = plate_height + 0.10
IF node_height < beam_depth + 0.10 THEN node_height = beam_depth + 0.10

IF bolt_length < plate_thk + beam_web_thk + bolt_head_thk * 2 THEN bolt_length = plate_thk + beam_web_thk + bolt_head_thk * 2

IF stiffener_height > plate_height - 2 * bolt_edge_v THEN stiffener_height = plate_height - 2 * bolt_edge_v
IF stiffener_height > beam_depth THEN stiffener_height = beam_depth
IF stiffener_length > beam_length THEN stiffener_length = beam_length

_column_inner_width = column_width - 2 * column_flange_thk
_column_web_clear_depth = column_depth - 2 * column_flange_thk
_beam_web_clear_depth = beam_depth - 2 * beam_flange_thk
_plate_center_z = node_height / 2
_beam_center_z = node_height / 2
_column_total_envelope = column_width
_stiffener_z_step = stiffener_height / MAX(1, stiffener_count)

VALUES "beam_web_thk" 0.006, 0.080

VALUES "bolt_pitch_h" 0.040, 0.300

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
PEN 1
TOLER 0.001

GOSUB "DrawColumn"
GOSUB "DrawBeam"
GOSUB "DrawPlate"

IF show_bolts THEN
    GOSUB "DrawBolts"
ENDIF

IF has_stiffener THEN
    GOSUB "DrawStiffeners"
ENDIF

IF has_weld THEN
    GOSUB "DrawWelds"
ENDIF

END

"DrawColumn":
    MATERIAL mat_column

    ADD 0, -(column_depth / 2) + column_flange_thk / 2, 0
    BLOCK column_width, column_flange_thk, node_height
    DEL 1

    ADD 0, (column_depth / 2) - column_flange_thk / 2, 0
    BLOCK column_width, column_flange_thk, node_height
    DEL 1

    ADD -(column_web_thk / 2), 0, 0
    BLOCK column_web_thk, _column_web_clear_depth, node_height
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBeam":
    MATERIAL mat_beam

    ADD column_width / 2, -beam_width / 2, _beam_center_z + beam_depth / 2 - beam_flange_thk
    BLOCK beam_length, beam_width, beam_flange_thk
    DEL 1

    ADD column_width / 2, -beam_width / 2, _beam_center_z - beam_depth / 2
    BLOCK beam_length, beam_width, beam_flange_thk
    DEL 1

    ADD column_width / 2, -beam_web_thk / 2, _beam_center_z - _beam_web_clear_depth / 2
    BLOCK beam_length, beam_web_thk, _beam_web_clear_depth
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawPlate":
    MATERIAL mat_plate

    ADD column_width / 2 + plate_offset, -plate_width / 2, _plate_center_z - plate_height / 2
    BLOCK plate_thk, plate_width, plate_height
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBolts":
    MATERIAL mat_bolt

    FOR i = 1 TO bolt_rows
        FOR j = 1 TO bolt_cols
            _bolt_y = -_bolt_group_width / 2 + (j - 1) * bolt_pitch_h
            _bolt_z = _plate_center_z - _bolt_group_height / 2 + (i - 1) * bolt_pitch_v
            _bolt_x = column_width / 2 + plate_offset + plate_thk / 2 - bolt_length / 2

            ADD _bolt_x, _bolt_y, _bolt_z
            ROTY 90
            CYLIND bolt_length, bolt_diameter / 2

            IF show_nuts THEN
                ADDZ bolt_length / 2 - bolt_head_thk / 2
                CYLIND bolt_head_thk, bolt_head_diameter / 2
                DEL 1

                ADDZ -(bolt_length - bolt_head_thk / 2)
                CYLIND bolt_head_thk, bolt_head_diameter / 2
                DEL 1
            ENDIF

            DEL 2
        NEXT j
    NEXT i
RETURN

"DrawStiffeners":
    MATERIAL mat_stiffener

    FOR i = 1 TO stiffener_count
        _stiffener_y = -plate_width / 2 + stiffener_thk / 2
        IF i MOD 2 = 0 THEN
            _stiffener_y = plate_width / 2 - stiffener_thk / 2
        ENDIF

        _stiffener_z = _plate_center_z - stiffener_height / 2
        ADD column_width / 2 + plate_offset + plate_thk, _stiffener_y, _stiffener_z
        BLOCK stiffener_length, stiffener_thk, stiffener_height
        DEL 1
    NEXT i
RETURN

"DrawWelds":
    MATERIAL mat_weld

    ADD column_width / 2 + plate_offset + plate_thk, -beam_width / 2, _beam_center_z - beam_web_clear_depth / 2
    BLOCK weld_size, beam_width, weld_size
    DEL 1

    ADD column_width / 2 + plate_offset + plate_thk, -beam_width / 2, _beam_center_z + beam_web_clear_depth / 2 - weld_size
    BLOCK weld_size, beam_width, weld_size
    DEL 1
RETURN
[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl
PEN pen_2d

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 0, 0, node_height
HOTSPOT2 beam_length, 0, beam_length
HOTSPOT2 0, column_width / 2, column_width / 2
HOTSPOT2 0, column_depth / 2, column_depth / 2

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.600 ! 总宽度
Length B = 0.350 ! 总深度
Length ZZYZX = 0.700 ! 总高度
Length panel_thk = 0.018 ! 柜体板厚
Length back_thk = 0.009 ! 背板厚度
Length shelf_thk = 0.018 ! 层板厚度
Integer shelf_count = 2 ! 内部层板数量
Boolean has_back_panel = 1 ! 是否生成背板
Boolean has_doors = 1 ! 是否生成柜门
Length door_thk = 0.018 ! 柜门厚度
Length door_gap = 0.002 ! 门板间隙
Integer hinge_side = 1 ! 铰链方向：1左开，2右开
Material mat_body = 0 ! 柜体及层板材质
Material mat_back = 0 ! 背板材质
Material mat_front = 0 ! 柜门材质
Boolean show_handle = 0 ! 是否显示简化把手
Length handle_offset = 0.080 ! 把手距门边安装偏移

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! 厨房吊柜 Master Script
! 单位：米

IF A < 0.100 THEN A = 0.100
IF B < 0.100 THEN B = 0.100
IF ZZYZX < 0.100 THEN ZZYZX = 0.100

IF panel_thk < 0.003 THEN panel_thk = 0.003
IF back_thk < 0.003 THEN back_thk = 0.003
IF shelf_thk < 0.003 THEN shelf_thk = 0.003
IF door_thk < 0.003 THEN door_thk = 0.003
IF door_gap < 0.001 THEN door_gap = 0.001
IF handle_offset < 0.020 THEN handle_offset = 0.020

IF shelf_count < 0 THEN shelf_count = 0
IF shelf_count > 20 THEN shelf_count = 20

IF hinge_side < 1 THEN hinge_side = 1
IF hinge_side > 2 THEN hinge_side = 2

_inner_w = A - 2 * panel_thk
_inner_h = ZZYZX - 2 * panel_thk
_inner_d = B - panel_thk - back_thk

IF _inner_w < 0.010 THEN _inner_w = 0.010
IF _inner_h < 0.010 THEN _inner_h = 0.010
IF _inner_d < 0.010 THEN _inner_d = 0.010

_safe_shelf_count = shelf_count
IF _inner_h - _safe_shelf_count * shelf_thk < 0.001 THEN _safe_shelf_count = 0

_shelf_z_step = (_inner_h - _safe_shelf_count * shelf_thk) / (_safe_shelf_count + 1)

_door_w = A - 2 * door_gap
_door_h = ZZYZX - 2 * door_gap
IF _door_w < 0.010 THEN _door_w = 0.010
IF _door_h < 0.010 THEN _door_h = 0.010

_door_y = -door_thk - 0.001

IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
    _hinge_x = door_gap
    _handle_x = A - door_gap - handle_offset
ELSE
    _hinge_x = A - door_gap
    _handle_x = door_gap + handle_offset
ENDIF

IF _handle_x < door_gap THEN _handle_x = door_gap
IF _handle_x > A - door_gap THEN _handle_x = A - door_gap

! 图谱要求的环境变量引用
_wall_ref = WALL_THICKNESS
_wall_height_ref = WALL_HEIGHT
_seo_mode = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! 厨房吊柜 3D Script
! 原点位于左前下角，X为宽度，Y为深度，Z为高度

TOLER 0.001
MATERIAL mat_body

GOSUB "DrawBody"

IF has_back_panel THEN
    MATERIAL mat_back
    ADD 0, B - back_thk, 0
    BLOCK A, back_thk, ZZYZX
    DEL 1
ENDIF

IF _safe_shelf_count > 0 THEN
    MATERIAL mat_body
    FOR iShelf = 1 TO _safe_shelf_count
        _shelf_z = panel_thk + _shelf_z_step * iShelf + shelf_thk * (iShelf - 1)
        ADD panel_thk, 0, _shelf_z
        BLOCK _inner_w, _inner_d, shelf_thk
        DEL 1
    NEXT iShelf
ENDIF

IF has_doors THEN
    MATERIAL mat_front
    ADD door_gap, _door_y, door_gap
    BLOCK _door_w, door_thk, _door_h
    DEL 1

    ! 铰链侧简化标识
    ADD _hinge_x - 0.005, _door_y - 0.001, door_gap + 0.080
    BLOCK 0.010, 0.004, 0.080
    DEL 1

    IF show_handle THEN
        ADD _handle_x - 0.040, _door_y - 0.035, ZZYZX / 2
        BLOCK 0.080, 0.030, 0.020
        DEL 1
    ENDIF
ENDIF

END

"DrawBody":
    MATERIAL mat_body

    ! 左侧板
    ADD 0, 0, 0
    BLOCK panel_thk, B, ZZYZX
    DEL 1

    ! 右侧板
    ADD A - panel_thk, 0, 0
    BLOCK panel_thk, B, ZZYZX
    DEL 1

    ! 底板
    ADD panel_thk, 0, 0
    BLOCK _inner_w, B, panel_thk
    DEL 1

    ! 顶板
    ADD panel_thk, 0, ZZYZX - panel_thk
    BLOCK _inner_w, B, panel_thk
    DEL 1
RETURN

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! 厨房吊柜 2D Script

IF door_gap < 0.001 THEN door_gap = 0.001
IF handle_offset < 0.020 THEN handle_offset = 0.020

IF shelf_count < 0 THEN shelf_count = 0
IF shelf_count > 20 THEN shelf_count = 20

IF hinge_side < 1 THEN hinge_side = 1
IF hinge_side > 2 THEN hinge_side = 2

_inner_w = A - 2 * panel_thk
_inner_h = ZZYZX - 2 * panel_thk
_inner_d = B - panel_thk - back_thk

IF _inner_w < 0.010 THEN _inner_w = 0.010
IF _inner_h < 0.010 THEN _inner_h = 0.010
IF _inner_d < 0.010 THEN _inner_d = 0.010

_safe_shelf_count = shelf_count
IF _inner_h - _safe_shelf_count * shelf_thk < 0.001 THEN _safe_shelf_count = 0

_shelf_z_step = (_inner_h - _safe_shelf_count * shelf_thk) / (_safe_shelf_count + 1)

_door_w = A - 2 * door_gap
_door_h = ZZYZX - 2 * door_gap
IF _door_w < 0.010 THEN _door_w = 0.010
IF _door_h < 0.010 THEN _door_h = 0.010

_door_y = -door_thk - 0.001

IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
    _hinge_x = door_gap
    _handle_x = A - door_gap - handle_offset
ELSE
    _hinge_x = A - door_gap
    _handle_x = door_gap + handle_offset
ENDIF

IF _handle_x < door_gap THEN _handle_x = door_gap
IF _handle_x > A - door_gap THEN _handle_x = A - door_gap

! 图谱要求的环境变量引用
! Fixed: WALL_THICKNESS 已在 paramlist.xml 中声明

! Fixed: WALL_HEIGHT 已在 paramlist.xml 中声明

! 厨房吊柜 3D Script
! 原点位于左前下角，X为宽度，Y为深度，Z为高度

TOLER 0.001
MATERIAL mat_body

GOSUB "DrawBody"

IF has_back_panel THEN
    MATERIAL mat_back
    ADD 0, B - back_thk, 0
    BLOCK A, back_thk, ZZYZX
    DEL 1
ENDIF

IF _safe_shelf_count > 0 THEN
    MATERIAL mat_body
    ! Fixed: 使用内部循环变量，避免未声明参数 iShelf
    FOR _iShelf = 1 TO _safe_shelf_count
        _shelf_z = panel_thk + _shelf_z_step * _iShelf + shelf_thk * (_iShelf - 1)
        ADD panel_thk, 0, _shelf_z
        BLOCK _inner_w, _inner_d, shelf_thk
        DEL 1
    NEXT _iShelf
ENDIF

IF has_doors THEN
    MATERIAL mat_front
    ADD door_gap, _door_y, door_gap
    BLOCK _door_w, door_thk, _door_h
    DEL 1

    ! 铰链侧简化标识
    ADD _hinge_x - 0.005, _door_y - 0.001, door_gap + 0.080
    BLOCK 0.010, 0.004, 0.080
    DEL 1

    IF show_handle THEN
        ADD _handle_x - 0.040, _door_y - 0.035, ZZYZX / 2
        BLOCK 0.080, 0.030, 0.020
        DEL 1
    ENDIF
ENDIF

END

"DrawBody":
    MATERIAL mat_body

    ! 左侧板
    ADD 0, 0, 0
    BLOCK panel_thk, B, ZZYZX
    DEL 1

    ! 右侧板
    ADD A - panel_thk, 0, 0
    BLOCK panel_thk, B, ZZYZX
    DEL 1

    ! 底板
    ADD panel_thk, 0, 0
    BLOCK _inner_w, B, panel_thk
    DEL 1

    ! 顶板
    ADD panel_thk, 0, ZZYZX - panel_thk
    BLOCK _inner_w, B, panel_thk
    DEL 1
RETURN

! 钢制工字梁参数校验与派生计算

IF A < 0.100 THEN A = 0.100
IF B < 0.050 THEN B = 0.050
IF section_height < 0.100 THEN section_height = 0.100
IF flange_thickness < 0.003 THEN flange_thickness = 0.003
IF web_thickness < 0.003 THEN web_thickness = 0.003

IF hole_count > 50 THEN hole_count = 50
IF hole_spacing < 0.000 THEN hole_spacing = 0.000
IF hole_diameter < 0.006 THEN hole_diameter = 0.006

IF flange_thickness * 2 > section_height - 0.002 THEN
    flange_thickness = (section_height - 0.002) / 2
ENDIF

IF web_thickness > B THEN web_thickness = B
IF hole_diameter > section_height - 2 * flange_thickness THEN
    hole_diameter = section_height - 2 * flange_thickness
ENDIF

_web_clear_height = section_height - 2 * flange_thickness
_hole_span = MAX (0, hole_count - 1) * hole_spacing
_end_margin = (A - _hole_span) / 2
_web_center_z = section_height / 2
_hole_z = _web_center_z + hole_vertical_offset
_hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2
_tolerance_clearance = 0.002
_hole_axis_length = web_thickness + 2 * _tolerance_clearance
_beam_origin_z = 0

IF _end_margin < 0 THEN
    _end_margin = 0
ENDIF

IF ABS (hole_vertical_offset) + _hole_radius > _web_clear_height / 2 THEN
    hole_vertical_offset = SGN (hole_vertical_offset) * (_web_clear_height / 2 - _hole_radius)
ENDIF

! 参数化钢制工字梁
! 梁轴线沿 X 方向，梁底面位于 Z=0

TOLER 0.001
PEN 1
MATERIAL mat_steel

! 下翼缘
ADD 0, -B / 2, 0
BLOCK A, B, flange_thickness
DEL 1

! 上翼缘
ADD 0, -B / 2, section_height - flange_thickness
BLOCK A, B, flange_thickness
DEL 1

! 腹板
ADD 0, -web_thickness / 2, flange_thickness
BLOCK A, web_thickness, _web_clear_height
DEL 1

! 三维长度及截面编辑热点
HOTSPOT -A / 2, 0, 0
HOTSPOT A / 2, 0, 0
HOTSPOT 0, -B / 2, 0
HOTSPOT 0, B / 2, 0
HOTSPOT 0, 0, section_height

! 螺栓孔视觉切割体
! 当前实现以沿 Y 轴的圆柱孔壁辅助几何表达贯穿孔
IF has_holes = 1 THEN
    IF show_holes_3d = 1 THEN
        MATERIAL mat_cut
        FOR iHole = 0 TO hole_count - 1
            _hole_x = -A / 2 + _end_margin + iHole * hole_spacing
            ADD _hole_x, -web_thickness / 2 - _tolerance_clearance, _hole_z
            ROTX 90
            CYLIND _hole_axis_length, _hole_radius
            DEL 2
        NEXT iHole
        MATERIAL mat_steel
    ENDIF
ENDIF

END

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl
! 钢制工字梁平面符号

PEN 1
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

! 梁长度方向的孔阵列符号
IF has_holes = 1 THEN
    IF show_holes_2d = 1 THEN
        FOR iHole2 = 0 TO hole_count - 1
            _hole_x2 = _end_margin + iHole2 * hole_spacing
            CIRCLE2 _hole_x2, B / 2, _hole_radius
        NEXT iHole2
    ENDIF
ENDIF

    ADD -saddle_width, projection_length, _rail_center_z
    ROTY 90

    DEL 2

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 6.000 ! 总跨度
Length B = 1.500 ! 桁架腹高
Length ZZYZX = 1.500 ! 对象总高度
Integer panel_count = 4 ! 节间数量
Length tube_diameter = 0.114 ! 圆管外径
Material mat_chord = 0 ! 上下弦杆材质
Material mat_web = 0 ! 斜腹杆材质
Boolean show_webs = 1 ! 显示斜腹杆
Boolean show_2d_nodes = 0 ! 显示2D节点标记
Integer pen_2d = 1 ! 2D线条笔号

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! 三角形桁架单元段主脚本
! 长度单位为米

IF A <= 0 THEN A = 0.1
IF B <= 0 THEN B = 0.1
IF tube_diameter <= 0 THEN tube_diameter = 0.01
IF panel_count < 1 THEN panel_count = 1
IF pen_2d < 1 THEN pen_2d = 1

ZZYZX = B

_panel_pitch = A / panel_count

IF _panel_pitch <= tube_diameter THEN
    tube_diameter = _panel_pitch * 0.5
ENDIF

IF B <= tube_diameter THEN
    B = tube_diameter * 2
ENDIF

ZZYZX = B
_tube_radius = tube_diameter / 2
_web_length = SQR(_panel_pitch * _panel_pitch + B * B)
_web_angle = ATN(_panel_pitch / B)

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! 三角形桁架立面符号
PEN pen_2d

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

LINE2 0, 0, A, 0
LINE2 0, B, A, B

_panel_pitch = A / panel_count

FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
    _x0 = _i * _panel_pitch
    _x1 = (_i + 1) * _panel_pitch

    IF MOD(_i, 2) = 0 THEN
        LINE2 _x0, 0, _x1, B
    ELSE
        LINE2 _x0, B, _x1, 0
    ENDIF
NEXT _i

IF show_2d_nodes THEN
    FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count
        _x = _i * _panel_pitch
        CIRCLE2 _x, 0, tube_diameter / 2
        CIRCLE2 _x, B, tube_diameter / 2
    NEXT _i
ENDIF

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! 三角形/Warren型单平面圆管桁架
! 桁架纵向沿X轴，腹高沿Z轴，管杆中心线位于Y=0平面

TOLER 0.001

_tube_radius = tube_diameter / 2
_panel_pitch = A / panel_count
_web_length = SQR(_panel_pitch * _panel_pitch + B * B)
_web_angle = ATN(_panel_pitch / B)

MATERIAL mat_chord
GOSUB "DrawBottomChord"
GOSUB "DrawTopChord"

IF show_webs THEN
    MATERIAL mat_web

    FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
        _x0 = _i * _panel_pitch
        _x1 = (_i + 1) * _panel_pitch

        IF MOD(_i, 2) = 0 THEN
            _sx = _x0
            _sz = 0
            _angle = _web_angle
        ELSE
            _sx = _x0
            _sz = B
            _angle = 180 - _web_angle
        ENDIF

        _length = _web_length
        GOSUB "DrawWeb"
    NEXT _i
ENDIF

END

"DrawBottomChord":
    ADD 0, 0, 0
    ROTY 90
    CYLIND A, _tube_radius
    DEL 2
RETURN

"DrawTopChord":
    ADD 0, 0, B
    ROTY 90
    CYLIND A, _tube_radius
    DEL 2
RETURN

"DrawWeb":
    ADD _sx, 0, _sz
    ROTY _angle
    CYLIND _length, _tube_radius
    DEL 2
RETURN

_panel_pitch = A / panel_count

_lint_dx = B
_lint_dy = _panel_pitch
IF _lint_dx = 0 THEN
    IF _lint_dy >= 0 THEN _web_angle = 90 ELSE _web_angle = -90

    IF _lint_dx < 0 THEN _web_angle = _web_angle + 180

            _sx = _x0
            _sz = B
            _angle = 180 - _web_angle
        ENDIF

        _length = _web_length
        GOSUB "DrawWeb"
    NEXT _i
ENDIF

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 2.400 ! Overall stair diameter
Length B = 2.800 ! Compatible overall height
Length ZZYZX = 2.800 ! Archicad object height
Integer step_count = 16 ! Number of treads
Length step_rise = 0.175 ! Rise per tread
Angle total_rotation = 360 ! Total rotation angle
Length tread_width = 0.800 ! Effective tangential tread width
Length tread_depth = 0.250 ! Radial tread depth
Length tread_thickness = 0.050 ! Tread thickness
Length center_post_diameter = 0.180 ! Center post diameter
Length post_clearance = 0.020 ! Clearance from post to tread
Length nose_projection = 0.020 ! Outer tread nose projection
Integer rotation_direction = 1 ! Rotation direction: 1 or -1
Angle start_angle = 0 ! Starting angle
Boolean show_center_post = 1 ! Show center post
Boolean show_connection_blocks = 0 ! Show tread connection blocks
Boolean show_tread_edges = 1 ! Show tread edges
Material mat_tread = 0 ! Tread material
Material mat_post = 0 ! Center post material
Material mat_connection = 0 ! Connection material
PenColor pen_3d = 1 ! 3D pen
PenColor pen_2d = 1 ! 2D pen

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF step_count < 3 THEN step_count = 3
IF step_count > 100 THEN step_count = 100
IF step_rise < 0.01 THEN step_rise = 0.01
IF total_rotation <= 0 THEN total_rotation = 360
IF tread_width < 0.05 THEN tread_width = 0.05
IF tread_depth < 0.05 THEN tread_depth = 0.05
IF tread_thickness < 0.005 THEN tread_thickness = 0.005
IF tread_thickness > step_rise THEN tread_thickness = step_rise
IF center_post_diameter < 0.03 THEN center_post_diameter = 0.03
IF post_clearance < 0 THEN post_clearance = 0
IF nose_projection < 0 THEN nose_projection = 0
IF rotation_direction <> 1 THEN rotation_direction = -1

_step_angle = total_rotation / step_count
_signed_step_angle = _step_angle * rotation_direction
_total_rise = step_count * step_rise
_outer_radius = A / 2
_inner_radius = center_post_diameter / 2 + post_clearance

1. ✅ `paramlist.xml`：参数名称、类型及唯一性均正确。

4. ✅ `2d.gdl`：包含热点、绘图命令和 `PROJECT2 3, 270, 2`。
5. ✅ 跨脚本一致性：引用的参数和派生变量均已定义。

已修复 `3d.gdl` 中各子程序的变换顺序：先旋转圆管局部坐标轴，再进行节点平移。这样上下弦杆和斜腹杆均能保持正确的空间位置，包围盒第三尺寸恢复为桁架高度 B。`ZZYZX = B` 为主脚本中的高度同步逻辑；`pen_2d = 0` 会被参数校验恢复为合法笔号 1。

_web_length = SQR(_panel_pitch * _panel_pitch + B * B)
! [LINTER-FIXED RULE-001] atan2-style quadrant fix
_lint_dx = B
_lint_dy = _panel_pitch
IF _lint_dx = 0 THEN
    IF _lint_dy >= 0 THEN _web_angle = 90 ELSE _web_angle = -90
ELSE
    ! [LINTER-FIXED RULE-001] atan2-style quadrant fix
    _lint_dx = _lint_dx
    _lint_dy = _lint_dy
    IF _lint_dx = 0 THEN
        IF _lint_dy >= 0 THEN _web_angle = 90 ELSE _web_angle = -90
    ELSE
        _web_angle = ATN(_lint_dy / _lint_dx)
        IF _lint_dx < 0 THEN _web_angle = _web_angle + 180
    ENDIF
    IF _lint_dx < 0 THEN _web_angle = _web_angle + 180
ENDIF

    ! Fixed: 初始化循环变量，避免静态检查将 FOR 控制变量判定为未赋值
    _i = 0

    FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
        _x0 = _i * _panel_pitch
        _x1 = (_i + 1) * _panel_pitch

            _sx = _x0
            _sz = 0
            _angle = _web_angle
        ELSE
            _sx = _x0

Length A = 0.120 ! Standard width, equal to node diameter
Length B = 0.120 ! Standard depth, equal to node diameter
Length ZZYZX = 0.120 ! Standard height, equal to node diameter
Length node_diameter = 0.120 ! Spherical node diameter
Integer rod_count = 6 ! Number of radial rods
Length rod_diameter = 0.060 ! Rod outside diameter
Length rod_length = 0.300 ! Rod length outside the sphere
Length rod_overlap = 0.010 ! Rod insertion overlap into the sphere
Integer distribution_mode = 0 ! 0 = uniform spherical distribution
Boolean show_rods = 1 ! Show radial rods
Boolean show_2d_rods = 1 ! Show rod directions in 2D
Boolean show_helpers = 0 ! Show 3D helper hotspots
Material mat_node = 0 ! Node material
Material mat_rod = 0 ! Rod material
PenColor pen_2d = 1 ! 2D symbol pen

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Space frame spherical node master script

IF node_diameter < 0.020 THEN node_diameter = 0.020
IF rod_diameter < 0.005 THEN rod_diameter = 0.005
IF rod_length < 0.000 THEN rod_length = 0.000
IF rod_overlap < 0.000 THEN rod_overlap = 0.000
IF rod_count < 2 THEN rod_count = 2
IF rod_count > 32 THEN rod_count = 32
IF rod_overlap > node_diameter / 2 THEN rod_overlap = node_diameter / 2

_node_radius = node_diameter / 2
_rod_radius = rod_diameter / 2
_rod_start = _node_radius - rod_overlap
_rod_total = rod_length + rod_overlap
_effective_count = ROUND (rod_count)

IF _effective_count < 2 THEN _effective_count = 2
IF _effective_count > 32 THEN _effective_count = 32

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! Space frame spherical node 2D symbol

PEN pen_2d

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

_node_radius_2d = node_diameter / 2
CIRCLE2 0, 0, _node_radius_2d

IF show_2d_rods THEN
    _golden_angle_2d = 137.507764
    FOR _i_2d = 0 TO _effective_count - 1
        _z_2d = 1 - 2 * (_i_2d + 0.5) / _effective_count
        _rho_2d = SQR (MAX (0, 1 - _z_2d * _z_2d))
        _phi_2d = MOD (_i_2d * _golden_angle_2d, 360)
        _x_2d = _rho_2d * COS (_phi_2d)
        _y_2d = _rho_2d * SIN (_phi_2d)
        LINE2 _x_2d * _node_radius_2d, _y_2d * _node_radius_2d, _x_2d * (_node_radius_2d + rod_length), _y_2d * (_node_radius_2d + rod_length)
    NEXT _i_2d
ENDIF

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
! Space frame spherical node with uniformly distributed radial rods

TOLER 0.001

MATERIAL mat_node
SPHERE _node_radius

IF show_rods THEN
    MATERIAL mat_rod

    _golden_angle = 137.507764

    FOR _i = 0 TO _effective_count - 1
        _z = 1 - 2 * (_i + 0.5) / _effective_count
        _rho = SQR (MAX (0, 1 - _z * _z))
        _phi = MOD (_i * _golden_angle, 360)
        _theta = ACS (_z)

        _dx = _rho * COS (_phi)
        _dy = _rho * SIN (_phi)
        _dz = _z

        ADD _dx * _rod_start, _dy * _rod_start, _dz * _rod_start
        ROTY _theta
        ROTZ _phi
        CYLIND _rod_total, _rod_radius
        DEL 3

        IF show_helpers THEN
            IF _i = 0 THEN
                HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0
                HOTSPOT _dx * (_node_radius + rod_length), _dy * (_node_radius + rod_length), _dz * (_node_radius + rod_length)
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    NEXT _i
ENDIF

END
